description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages app navigation, toolbar and footer interactions, menu actions, and observes cart data to update UI elements such as the cart badge.
external_files: R (resources: layouts, menus, strings, and views)

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An AppCompatActivity subclass managing navigation, menu, and footer interactions in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the toolbar, navigation controller, footer, and observes cart data for UI updates.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates the cart badge in the menu based on current cart items.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation and actions.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed.

methods.name: bindFooterNavigation
methods.description: Sets up footer button click listeners for navigation.

methods.name: safeNavigateToTopLevel
methods.description: Performs navigation to a top-level destination with debounce logic to prevent rapid repeated taps.
